entries.contract: ontology_propose "record one ontology observation ... A new value supersedes the prior" (src/core/ops/chronicle.ts:153-188), exposed as CLI `gbrain ontology-add`; the capability matrix lists it on OP, STDIO, HTTP and CLI.
entries.surface: ontology_propose -> engine.mergeOntologyFact (src/core/pglite-engine.ts:2263, src/core/postgres-engine.ts) inserts into facts directly; the managed_writer_guard trigger (src/core/persistence/writer-guard-schema.ts) rejects it on every brain made by `gbrain init`
entries.expected: `gbrain ontology-add people/alice-example location Lisbon` records the observation (action inserted) and ontology_get returns location = Lisbon.
entries.actual: exit 1 "writer_coordinator_required: canonical writer must use the persistence coordinator"; ontology_get returns []. In N1 every ontology write was refused in all 6 cells (3 transports x 2 engines), so every ontology current-value and as-of probe is a scored miss.

entries.contract: ontology_propose: "A new value supersedes the prior" (src/core/ops/chronicle.ts:153-188); ontology_get returns the value valid at asof.
entries.surface: mergeOntologyFact ON CONFLICT (source_id, entity_slug, dimension, value_hash, source_markdown_slug) DO NOTHING (src/core/pglite-engine.ts:2298-2306 and the Postgres twin): the key has no time component, so a return to an earlier value with the same provenance is a no-op
entries.expected: Lisbon (2020), Porto (2022), Lisbon again (2024): ontology_get now returns Lisbon; as-of 2024-06 returns Lisbon.
entries.actual: The third write returns action "noop"; ontology_get returns Porto now and at every date after 2022. In the N1 in-process arm the same-source revert chain is stale served on its current probe and wrong on the as-of probe after the revert; the distinct-source revert chain passes.

entries.contract: Facts with visibility "private" are local-only: remote callers get world facts only (find_trajectory D-CDX-1 in src/core/ops/insights.ts:250-338, recall, context_pack "Ignored (world-only) for remote callers"); ontology_propose stores visibility (default private).
entries.surface: ontology_get (src/core/ops/chronicle.ts:128-151) and getOntology: remote callers lose only diary-sourced rows and rows whose provenance page is private (privateProvenanceFilterFragment); facts.visibility is never checked
entries.expected: A remote ontology_get on an entity with a private risk_tolerance observation and a world decision_style observation returns decision_style only.
entries.actual: It returns both, including "risk_tolerance=high (private marker)". Masked on default brains today by N1-1 (the write is refused); reachable on any brain whose ontology rows were written another way, and on every brain once N1-1 is fixed.

entries.contract: Not claimed: implicit supersession is a near-duplicate rule (cosine >= 0.95, same kind, different text; src/core/facts/write-single.ts) and is skipped with no embedding provider; no natural-language change detection exists (capability matrix N1).
entries.expected: Gap, not a failure: a changed value ("Home city is Lisbon" then "Home city is Porto") is not detected as an update.
entries.actual: Keyless: dedup and supersession are skipped (degraded_dedup). With real embeddings (paid arm): 0 of 10 value changes superseded, 0 of 10 unrelated controls superseded, 10 of 10 punctuation-only near duplicates deduplicated, so the dedup path ran and value changes stay as separate active facts.
entries.reason: feature gap at the tested commit; explicit fence supersession is the documented update path and passed every probe

entries.contract: find_trajectory metric takes a canonical metric name (src/core/ops/insights.ts:250-338); the fence parser maps aliases such as burn to burn_rate (src/core/facts/extract-from-fence.ts:135).
entries.repro: first dev run of bun eval/runner/n1-knowledge-update.ts --engines pglite --interfaces mcp-stdio
entries.expected: The generator writes canonical metric names.
entries.actual: It wrote claim_metric "burn", which gbrain stored as "burn_rate", so find_trajectory metric=burn returned nothing to every caller and the exposure control had no signal.
entries.reason: category defect fixed in gbrain-evals before the counted run (the chain now uses burn_rate); gbrain behaves as documented

entries.contract: Private fence rows never enter search chunks for any caller (src/core/facts-fence.ts "Layer A" chunker strip).
entries.surface: eval/generators/n1-knowledge-update-gen.ts n1Probes (search probes for private fence chains)
entries.expected: No search probe targets a private fence chain.
entries.actual: The first counted run scored 16 search probes for the two private chains on the trusted CLI cells (8 PGLite, 8 Postgres); they failed by construction.
entries.reason: category defect fixed in gbrain-evals (a6d9f45) and N1 rerun; every other number was identical between the two runs

entries.contract: `forget` withdraws a fact from active recall (src/core/facts/forget.ts header; docs/guides/memory-boundaries.md); context_pack is a memory verb that packs hot facts; the hot-memory cache says it is "Refreshed on extraction event via bumpCache" (src/core/facts/meta-hook.ts:10).
entries.surface: getBrainHotMemoryMeta (src/core/facts/meta-hook.ts:65-176): a 30 s per-process cache of the ten most recent facts, served by context_pack and attached as _meta.brain_hot_memory to every MCP tool response; bumpHotMemoryCache (meta-hook.ts:179) has no caller, so forget never invalidates it
entries.expected: Right after forget returns, neither context_pack nor any response _meta carries the withdrawn claim.
entries.actual: Both still carry it for up to 30 s in a running stdio or HTTP server. N5 counted run: 2 prohibited context_pack outputs on the PGLite cells and 12 on Postgres; 108 PGLite and 304 Postgres remote responses carried a forgotten canary in _meta after its forget returned.

entries.contract: forget withdraws only the forgotten claim; other facts on the page stay readable (src/core/facts/withdrawal.ts). A refused write is not applied: owner_unavailable is a retryable refusal (src/core/connectors/item-holds.ts:97).
entries.surface: forget under concurrent CLI writes on PGLite: recordFactWithdrawal deletes the page chunks in the commit (src/core/facts/withdrawal.ts:45-50); its withdrawal-mirror, git and embedding effects can stay queued after the committing process exits
entries.expected: Either the forget is refused and nothing changes, or it is acknowledged and the page chunks are rebuilt, so retained facts on the page stay searchable.
entries.actual: The page keeps 0 chunks and its retained facts are missing from search, query and the recall query arm until an unrelated later write drains the queue (repro: 2 of 5 rounds, with forget returning ok). In the N5 PGLite CLI cell both late forgets answered owner_unavailable although they had committed, and 4 retained neighbors (12 of 750 retained pairs) went missing from the chunk tiers.

entries.contract: After forget, "Remember a corrected claim. Repeating the old claim does not restore withdrawn memory." (src/core/facts/write-single.ts:105-110): a corrected claim is the documented way back.
entries.surface: remember right after forget on the same entity, PGLite, trusted CLI (`gbrain call remember`)
entries.expected: The corrected claim is accepted (status inserted) on the first try.
entries.actual: The first remember after a forget fails with "scope_denied: The source file bytes changed after this request was accepted." (2 of 2 in the repro, with and without a vault source); an identical retry succeeds. Postgres CLI and the stdio and HTTP servers accept it. In N5 it fails the reinstatement floor in the PGLite CLI cell.

entries.contract: Not claimed: withdrawal fingerprints fold case, whitespace and listed punctuation only (src/core/facts/withdrawal-schema.ts:1-17).
entries.expected: Gap, not a failure: a paraphrase of a forgotten claim ("Is a beekeeper" after forgetting "Keeps bees") stays active.
entries.actual: 6 of 6 paraphrases (2 per PGLite cell) stayed active after their originals were forgotten.
entries.reason: documented non-guarantee (amendment 2): semantic paraphrase retraction is not claimed

entries.contract: Not claimed: "These are retractions: original prose, files and backups may retain text" (src/core/facts/forget.ts header); page history, vault Git history and struck fence rows are kept by design.
entries.surface: get_versions, vault Git history, prose outside the fence, struck fence rows
entries.expected: Gap, not a failure: forgotten claims remain in history and source material.
entries.actual: On the PGLite cells: 30 forgotten-token hits in get_versions, 24 in the vault Git history, 9 prose chunk hits for the prose canary, 126 struck "forgotten:" fence-row sightings.
entries.reason: documented non-guarantee (amendment 2): physical erasure is not claimed

entries.contract: Not claimed: forget does not write to takes, ontology, timeline or synthesized pages (capability matrix N5).
entries.surface: dream synthesis and consolidation; takes; synthesized pages
entries.repro: not run hermetically: these phases call a chat model
entries.expected: Gap: a claim consolidated into a take or a synthesized page before the forget would stay there.
entries.actual: Unmeasured in this slice (no chat model; no fake chat endpoint wired). Listed so it is not mistaken for a zero.
entries.reason: feature gap at the tested commit, and an unmeasured tier in this slice

entries.contract: context_pack hot facts are the ten most recent facts in the source (src/core/facts/meta-hook.ts DEFAULT_TOP_K), not an exhaustive list.
entries.repro: first N5 dev run: bun eval/runner/n5-forget-residue.ts --engines pglite --interfaces mcp-http
entries.expected: Retained recall counts only exhaustive tiers.
entries.actual: The first definition counted context_pack, where retained neighbors drop out when newer facts arrive, so retained recall fell below 1 without any withdrawal.
entries.reason: category defect fixed in gbrain-evals with an erratum before the counted run: context_pack still counts for residue, not for retained recall; the receipt also reports retained recall with it included
